subject: general
question:
Select the segment which has a grammatical error in the given sentence. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

One of my friends have a house in Shimla.
solution:
The correct answer is **"friends have a house".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• In English, when we say "one of [plural noun]", the verb should agree with "one", which is singular.
